title: Product Information Overrides (per store, locale or account text)
summary: A system table of alternate name, descriptions or SKU per store, locale and optional account. Disabled by default (two flags). The stock Webstore does not read it, so showing overrides needs a customization calling the override API.
when_to_use: different product name or description per store, account or locale
not_for: different price, stock, images, attributes or SEO per store
anything that must be saved on the order
limitations: No uniqueness rule; duplicates fail at search time
Needs a full catalog publish to reach search
Account fallback behaviour differs between code and API reference
platform_change_if: a schema change to the system table
showing overrides on the stock storefront without a customization

unverified: account-code fallback on the customer's version
